name: warranty_triage
description: Classifies warranty claims by product, fault category and urgency.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials issued by the service-desk authorization server

skills.name: Triage warranty claim
skills.description: Reads a warranty claim, identifies the product by serial number, assigns a fault category (battery, motor, frame, display, other) and an urgency from 1 to 3, and records the triage.
examples: Claim C-1042: serial EB-2291-0042, battery will not hold charge.
